apparatus_transformations.policy: Standalone ornaments and speaker/prose headings become # APPARATUS: comments; printed chorus labels become [CHORUS], preserving any words following the label. Exact source/output text is recorded per candidate.
apparatus_transformations.bracket_normalization: Remove supplied-word square brackets, preserving their enclosed verse text; remove editorial [sic] and [?] tags. Every changed extracted line has exact before/after evidence.

reader_validation.method: Generate each eligible item with integration marked_text into a temporary staged file, then compare every lyric row from normalized_rows with all intended non-apparatus candidate lines, in exact order.
